info.title: CIP Control Plane API
info.description: REST API contract for the deployable CIP control plane. This prerelease schema documents runtime, admin, and operational endpoints.

get.description: Fetch the deployment-scoped compliance profile used by runtime clients before interaction starts.

post.description: Record that a required AI disclosure was presented to the end user. UI rendering remains the application's responsibility.
Record a human review decision tied to the session. Verified operator identity overrides any caller-supplied reviewer id.

put.description: Create or update the deployment-scoped compliance profile used for AI Act support, disclosure requirements, and high-risk activation gates.

post.description: Create a deployment-scoped compliance artifact used for high-risk activation gates and evidence export.

actorVerification.description: Trusted provenance for the persisted actor. Caller-supplied actor values on generic ingestion are treated as asserted, not verified.
Trusted provenance for the persisted actor. Caller-supplied actor values on generic ingestion are treated as asserted, not verified.
